aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When former criminal profiler Unai 'Kraken' López de Ayala receives a mysterious ultimatum to find a rare centuries-old manuscript or lose his mother, he must dive into the dangerous world of rare book collecting to uncover dark family secrets.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In Vitoria, former criminal profiler Unai López de Ayala, known as Kraken, receives a shocking anonymous threat: he has seven days to locate the legendary and priceless manuscript known as 'The Black Book of Hours.' If he fails, the kidnappers will kill his mother, a woman he believed had been dead for decades. Reaming up with his trusted partner Esti, Kraken travels between Vitoria and Madrid to navigate the secretive world of bibliophiles, art forgery, and murder. As time runs out, every discovery forces him to confront a past that is far different from what he was led to believe.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Retired criminal profiler Unai 'Kraken' López de Ayala finds his peaceful life shattered when an anonymous extortionist named Calibán makes a terrifying demand. Unai is given just one week to retrieve the 'Black Book of Hours,' an exceptionally rare medieval manuscript and one of only seven in existence. The ransom for failing is the death of his mother—a revelation that paralyzes Kraken, as he had buried her decades ago. Teaming up once again with his former colleague Esti, Kraken steps back into investigative work, following a path littered with murdered booksellers across Vitoria and Madrid. His search immerses him in the lucrative and treacherous underworld of elite bibliophiles, literary forgery, and black-market antiquities. Meanwhile, police investigations into connected bookstore homicides bring Unai under scrutiny while leading him toward a mysterious figure known as Ítaca Expósito. Desperate and racing against an expiring clock, Kraken breaks police protocol to break into key locations across the capital. Each step uncovers shocking truths regarding his family heritage, proving that his mother's death was staged and that his past was built on a web of deception. Ultimately, Unai must decipher complex historical clues and catch a brilliant killer before his mother's fate is sealed forever.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Based on the bestselling novel by Eva García Sáenz de Urturi, 'Kraken: El libro negro de las horas' is a gripping Spanish crime thriller directed by Manuel Sanabria and Joaquín Llamas. Set in 2022, former inspector and criminal profiler Unai 'Kraken' López de Ayala (Alejo Sauras) leads a quiet life until an unexpected phone call upends his reality. An anonymous voice gives him a strict seven-day deadline to retrieve a legendary bibliographical jewel—the Black Book of Hours—or his mother will be killed. Shocked by the claim that his mother, who he believed died decades ago, is alive and held hostage, Kraken teams up with inspector Esti (Maggie Civantos) to track down the manuscript. Their race against time takes them through Vitoria and the secretive bibliophile circles of Madrid, uncovering a string of deliberate murders targeting prominent booksellers. Combining high-stakes suspense, intricate detective profiler puzzles, and deep personal trauma, the narrative explores the dark intersections of literary obsession, forgery, and family secrets.

story_structure.climax: Kraken confronts the mastermind behind the ransom plot in a high-tension showdown, uncovering the shocking truth about his mother's past and the dark history surrounding the creation and ownership of 'The Black Book of Hours'.
story_structure.conflict: The demand forces Kraken into an impossible dilemma: his mother was believed to have died decades ago. Unsure if the threat is a sadistic hoax or a revelation of a buried family secret, he is thrust into a high-stakes race against time across Vitoria and Madrid to track down the priceless bibliographic treasure.
story_structure.resolution: With the mystery of his mother's fate and the true origin of the manuscript finally brought to light, Kraken secures safety for his loved ones, coming to terms with his rewritten past and finding closure amid the fallout of the conspiracy.
story_structure.introduction: Former criminal profiler Unai López de Ayala, known as Kraken, is living a quiet life in Vitoria when he receives an unsettling anonymous call. The mysterious voice threatens to kill his mother unless he retrieves the legendary medieval manuscript known as 'The Black Book of Hours' within one week.
story_structure.risingAction: Teaming up with his trusted former colleague Esti and navigating the dark underbelly of rare book collectors, Kraken delves deep into a series of mysterious crimes tied to antiquarian booksellers. As he connects past family secrets with present-day murders, he follows a trail of hidden identities, forged manuscripts, and historical archives that bring him closer to the caller's true identity.
